raw_text: Iran marked the first anniversary of Mahsa Amini's death with sporadic protests across major cities despite an unprecedented security crackdown. The Islamic Republic preemptively detained hundreds of activists and imposed internet restrictions in Kurdish regions. Diaspora communities organized large solidarity marches in Berlin, London, Paris, Toronto, and Washington. Rights groups say at least 20,000 people remain imprisoned from last year's protests.
clean_text: Iran marks Amini anniversary with sporadic protests and mass detentions. Hundreds of activists preemptively arrested. 20,000 still imprisoned from last year.
